title: nopal.memory_provider/v1 contract descriptor
description: Descriptor for a MemoryProvider implementation consumable by nopal. Mirrors the execution contract's descriptor style: it names the operations, guarantees, and degraded shapes a provider must expose; per-operation payload validation lives in the conformance runner.

style.description: Transport is not frozen; json_subprocess is the reference. Alternatives must expose the same concepts and pass the runner.

degraded_shapes.description: Stable degraded responses (e.g. lock_unavailable skip, dead-letter) that consumers must handle.

capture_then_recall.description: A run lesson ingested with run_id and ticket_id is findable by either identifier via memory.search immediately afterward.

fail_closed_lock.description: Lock-unavailable degrades reads to a skipped shape and routes writes to dead-letter; never silent unlocked access.

miss_envelope.description: Search misses carry miss.reason from an open vocabulary plus recovery hints.

in_band_errors.description: Errors are JSON with stable reason codes; unknown codes are handled conservatively.

reason_codes.description: Known stable reason codes. Open vocabulary: additive codes do not require a version bump.
